blocks.arabic_text: يَعْمَلُ الْعَمَلَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَيَحْمَدُهُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ؟ قَالَ: تِلْكَ عَاجِلُ بُشْرَي الْمُؤْمِنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب اذا اثني علي الصالح...، رقم:٦٧٢١
blocks.tamil_translation: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, “A person does good deeds, and because of that people praise him. Will he get the reward of that good deed? Does people's praising him not count as Riya (showing off)?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “This is glad tidings that reaches the Mu'min immediately,” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of the hadith is that one glad tiding is the one to be received in the Hereafter, and the other is the one received in this world through people praising him. His intention should be only for the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala; if his good deed is not done with the aim of being praised, then his being praised by people without his wishing it is an immediate glad tiding he receives in this world.

blocks.arabic_text:
عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ: سَاَلْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ عَنْ هذِهِ اْلآيَةِ (وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْتُوْنَ مآ آتَوْا وَقُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ۞) (المؤمنون:٦٠)
قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ﵂: اَهُمُ الَّذِيْنَ يَشْرَبُوْنَ الْخَمْرَ وَيَسْرِقُوْنَ؟ قَالَ: لَا، يَا بِنْتَ الصِّدِّيْقِ! وَلكِنَّهُمُ الَّذِيْنَ يَصُوْمُوْنَ وَيُصَلُّوْنَ وَيَتَصَدَّقُوْنَ وَهُمْ يَخَافُوْنَ اَنْ لَا يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ أُولئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُسَارِعُوْنَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُوْنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب ومن سورة المؤمنين: رقم:٣١٧٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) says, “I asked the Prophet ﷺ, “Is the meaning of this ayah, ()وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْتُوْنَ مآ آتَوْا وَقُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ “those who give what they give while their hearts are fearful on account of their giving, those who drink wine and those who steal?” (Are they afraid because they have engaged in sins?) I asked.
